press_references.value: Banque Saudi Fransi Launches Next-Gen Digital Banking Platform with Backbase

product_launches.description: Banque Saudi Fransi launched a next-generation digital banking platform, developed with Backbase and Hexaware, featuring enhanced security, improved payment solutions, and a unified omnichannel experience.

overview_description.description: Banque Saudi Fransi is a joint-stock company that offers a comprehensive range of banking services, including personal and corporate banking, Islamic finance, investment solutions, and digital banking platforms. BSF's offerings encompass savings and current accounts, personal and home loans, credit and debit cards, as well as structured finance, trade finance, and asset management services through its subsidiary, BSF Capital.
